Other Observations

33. Tenability along the means of escape is undoubtedly a critical factor affecting the evacuation of residents. However, in the cases of Wang Cheong House and Wang Tai House, the obstruction of entrances / exits at the ground level should not be overlooked. According to CCTV footages, the front entrance or rear exit of Wang Tai House was blocked by fallen lit bamboo scaffoldings and combustible materials, making it impossible for residents to escape from the building through that means of escape.

34. Meanwhile, the initial Incident Commander of this fire, Senior Station Officer HUI Kin-on, observed that the front entrance and rear exit of Wang Cheong House were blocked by those collapsed burning scaffoldings at about 1505 hours and 1457 hours respectively. Whereas for Wang Tai House, the front entrance and rear exit were blocked by those collapsed burning scaffoldings at about 1520 hours and 1530 hours respectively.

35. According to the following CCTV footages of lifts L13, L14 and L15 of Wang Tai House, evacuees’ attempts to escape were futile, resulting in their demises:

i. ██████████████████████████ who arrived at G/F at about 1520 hours using lift L13, failed to exit the lift at G/F due to blockage of the exit by burning bamboo scaffoldings. ███ peeked out from the lift but were too afraid to escape through the fire, as shown in Photo 11. ███ chose to retreat into the lift and went upwards. Unfortunately, the tenability of the lift lobbies on upper floors deteriorated so quickly, as mentioned in paragraph 30, resulting in the loss of ███ lives;
